edit_definition.molecule_scope: all 4200 original rows; single connected component; no explicit-H node; no desalting, deduplication, stereo removal or graph rewriting
edit_definition.cut: every bridge edge with OGB bond type SINGLE (0); bridge supplies non-ring
edit_definition.core: C = complement of S; >= 10 heavy atoms and >= 75% of each parent's heavy atoms
edit_definition.core_identity: exact coloured incidence graph of C using all 9 OGB atom columns, port colour and all 3 cut-bond columns; no WL-only, SMILES-only or approximate match
edit_definition.excluded_from_edits: official row 1646 (valid) is the only multi-component molecule; no explicit-H molecule exists
edit_definition.direction: S native key (rd_fragment exact fragment key) lexicographic smaller end is A; delta = B - A
edit_definition.transformation_id: ordered (S_A native key, S_B native key, cut-bond type/stereo/conjugated)

merge: rows with identical full canonical isomeric SMILES
all endpoints of pairs sharing the exact matched core_id
support_components.unit: pair-bearing component; molecules are never counted as independent experiments when they occur in one component

sets.E_T: pairs with at least one official Test endpoint
sets.E_HH_T: E_T pairs with neither endpoint in Train
sets.E_STRICT: E_HH_T pairs whose exact matched core_id occurs in no legal Train cut and whose transformation_id occurs in a Train-Train pair in another component
sets.E_STRICT_C_ONLY: descriptive variant using only the C graph key (not cut-bond columns) for Train-seen

dictionaries.rule: certified SLSQP row where available; otherwise the frozen FW64 alpha is retained

TRAIN_TRANSFORM_MEAN.rule: for each transformation_id, average delta_y within each source component, then average over source components, excluding the evaluated pair's entire component
TRAIN_TRANSFORM_MEAN.subset: comparisons with this reference use exactly the pairs where it is defined

metrics.gain_definition: reference error minus candidate error; positive means the candidate is better
metrics.dictionary_split: delta-fidelity to native RESP and error to true delta_y are separate tables
metrics.ci: 2.5/97.5 percentiles; NA when fewer than 2 pair-bearing components in the scope
metrics.low_support_note: small component/molecule counts are reported as limitations, not as an automatic decision label

influence.rule: remove one Test molecule and every E_T pair containing it; recompute the fixed gains; report range and sign reversals

coverage_fields.shared_selected_core_view: both endpoints have a fixed <=4 selected view with the same C exact key and cut-bond columns; coverage only, never a subset selector
coverage_fields.s_in_inventory: S native key belongs to the existing dictionary's 702 Train S-word candidates from fixed selected Train views

stop_rules: no training, optimizer update, new seed, new dataset, LR/K/rank/panel sweep
no change to official Train/Valid/Test, <=4 views, aggregation, fallback, dictionary, alpha or projector
no relaxation of the edit definition if held-out support is small
no claim of held-out generalisation from Train molecules
no substitute s(C,S_B)-s(C,S_A) for the full F(G)
small or empty E_STRICT is a valid final result
